description:
The container-tools module contains tools for working with containers, notably podman, buildah, skopeo, and runc.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * crun: crun: Arbitrary file creation/overwrite via symlink following (CVE-2026-47766)
  * podman: podman: The `podman run` command can be instructed to disable almost all sandboxing - including user-requested sandboxing - by image annotation (CVE-2026-94603)
  * net/textproto: mime/multipart: golang: golang: Denial of Service via memory limit bypass in multipart form parsing (CVE-2026-94440)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * Bug in runc causes containers to fail to start with "unsafe procfs detected: openat2 /proc/thread-self/fd/: function not implemented" (JIRA:RHEL-133969)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
solution:
For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
